Kevin Trudeau stuttered, was tongue-tied, and terrified of rejection - the last person anyone would hire to sell cars.

An ad in the paper said experienced salesman only need apply. He had zero experience. He applied anyway, and when the manager pushed back, Kevin asked one question right back: if the guy was so good, why is he looking for a job?

The manager didn't know what to say. Kevin got hired on the spot, straight commission, no experience required.

The interview itself was the sales technique: ask a question, and let the other person convince himself.

#kevintrudeau #salestraining #persuasiontips #wealthmindset #businessmotivation #entrepreneurtips

Kevin Trudeau says persuasion isn't about talking - it's six words: what, when, where, who, how and why.

Ask specific questions and people start developing affinity with you, because you're showing genuine interest instead of trying to convince them of anything.

Then add two magic phrases: why is that, and tell me more. Say this is fascinating, I want to hear more to someone, and Kevin says they light up like a Christmas tree - they instantly like you more.

You've just won them as a friend, and now they're open to whatever you suggest next.

#kevintrudeau #persuasiontips #salestraining #wealthmindset #communicationskills #businessmotivation

Larry was a new car salesman who had all the training but couldn't find the words - shy, nervous, and not a natural talker.

Kevin Trudeau gave him one tool: whenever a customer said anything, just ask why is that, and listen.

A customer said he wanted a four-door. Why is that? We have kids now, they need more room. The customer kept talking, and kept selling himself the car, while Larry just listened and nodded.

Larry's confidence shot up. He upgraded to tell me more about that - and the customer said, show me the car.

#kevintrudeau #salestraining #persuasiontips #wealthmindset #communicationskills #businessmotivation

A friend begged Kevin Trudeau to teach him how to sell - Kevin had done billions in TV sales, and the friend wanted the secret.

Kevin brought him to Ojai, California for three days and never trained him once. They hiked, drove a 1944 Willys Jeep, shopped, watched a movie. The friend kept asking when the training would start.

On the last day, two hours before he left, the friend finally gave up waiting - and Kevin told him: the secret is genuine interest in what the other person wants, not in how you sell.

As Zig Ziglar put it: you can always sell John Jones what he buys, if you see it through John Jones's eyes.

#kevintrudeau #salestraining #persuasiontips #wealthmindset #businessmotivation #entrepreneurtips

When Kevin Trudeau got hired as a car salesman with zero experience, he didn't guess how to sell - he found the top three salesmen on the leaderboard and followed them around.

He watched exactly how they greeted people, how they asked questions, and how they listened like they genuinely cared about every answer.

Show real interest, actually listen, and repeat back what someone tells you, and that person starts to trust you before you've sold them anything.

Kevin watched first, copied what worked, and only then started closing deals of his own.

#kevintrudeau #salestraining #persuasiontips #wealthmindset #businessmotivation #entrepreneurtips

Kevin Trudeau was tongue-tied, stuttering and terrified of other people. Today people call him a master communicator who's generated billions of dollars in sales.

The first thing he was ever taught wasn't what to say - it was the intention behind it. Real persuasion isn't convincing someone of your idea. It's being genuinely interested in theirs.

You have two ears and one mouth, and Kevin says you have to use them in that proportion: listen more than you talk.

Most people just wait for their turn to speak. The ones who actually listen are the ones people remember.
